name: Danish Refugee Council
summary: Denmark's largest humanitarian NGO (Dansk Flygtningehjælp), working with refugees and displaced people in 28 countries: cash and livelihoods, protection and legal aid, shelter, water and sanitation, humanitarian mine action and peacebuilding, site management, a standby roster of experts for UN agencies and the Mixed Migration Centre's research, plus asylum counselling and integration work in Denmark; almost all its income is government, EU and UN grants. Modelled on its audited 2025 accounts.

spending.source: https://drc.ngo/media/govow2w2/drc_annual-report_2025_final.pdf (Annual Report 2025, financial statements audited by Deloitte, year to 31 December 2025, notes 5, 6 and 9, pp. 64-66: project-related expenses DKK 3,144,332 thousand, the Ministry of Immigration and Integration's grants DKK 38,796 thousand, own activities DKK 36,610 thousand and special-purpose activities DKK 11,535 thousand, of total costs DKK 3,469,657 thousand; excludes fundraising DKK 40,806 thousand and administration DKK 197,578 thousand. Kroner converted at $0.151126 a krone, the IRS's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_dkk_2025).)

lines.label: Programmes: international programmes (economic recovery and cash, protection, shelter, WASH and infrastructure, mine action and peacebuilding, site management, the Standby Roster, the Mixed Migration Centre) and work in Denmark
